title: Microsoft signs first fusion power purchase agreement with Helion

sources.quote: Today we announced that Microsoft has agreed to purchase electricity from Helion’s first fusion power plant, scheduled for deployment in 2028.
Photo courtesy Helion Microsoft said Wednesday it has signed a power purchase agreement with nuclear fusion startup Helion Energy to buy electricity from it in 2028.

explain: Microsoft agreed to buy electricity from Helion's first fusion power plant, targeted for 2028 in Washington state (reported as at least 50 MW). It was the first-ever fusion power purchase agreement; financial terms were not disclosed. Plant: Helion's planned Orion fusion plant, Malaga, Washington (not yet operating).
